name: comp-455
title: Ghost Arrow Pagination
description: A minimum pagination footer with a ghost Previous on the left and Next on the right; hovering slides the small arrow a touch outward and no button gains a fill.
use: A light pagination footer under a table where numbered pages would add clutter.
avoid: When people need to jump far: only back and forward exist, with no page numbers.
a11y: Buttons have clear text and an aria-disabled state, but the arrow nudge has no reduced-motion alternative. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card holds four thin invoice rows split by hairlines; beneath them a footer row sets a background-free Previous with a left arrow at the left edge and Next with a right arrow at the right edge.
behaves: Hovering Previous nudges its left arrow slightly left and hovering Next nudges its right arrow slightly right, while the rows and card stay still. The buttons never take a filled background.
customise: Pass currentPage and totalPages to drive the labels and disabled state; the arrow nudge, ghost styling and spacing are fixed in the classes.
weight: light: Two ghost buttons with a tiny transform; nothing loops or runs heavy work.
demo: Invoice rows INV-2031 to INV-2034 for Acme Corp, Globex, Initech and Umbrella with amounts and statuses.
issues: Neither button has an onClick handler, so the demo cannot actually change page.
polishWhy: Restrained ghost pagination with a neat arrow nudge; a very familiar pattern.
